sections.title: Audio Converter Workbench
sections.subtitle: Professional lossless and high-fidelity audio transcoding powered by ffmpeg and flac.

sections.title: System PATH Toolchain Probe
sections.details: Environment status: FFmpeg [Detected / Available] | FLAC [Detected / Available]. Audio transcoding binaries verified in system PATH.

sections.title: Transcoding Queue (Job List)
sections.details: Right-click any song in your track list and select 'Add to Convert Queue' to populate this queue. Tracks will be converted in sequence upon clicking 'Start Transcoding'.

sections.title: Target Format Configuration
sections.details: Supported target formats: FLAC (Lossless compression levels 0-8), WAV (16-bit / 24-bit / 32-bit Float PCM), MP3 (320kbps CBR / V0 VBR), AAC/M4A (256kbps), Opus (64k-320k VBR), and OGG Vorbis.

sections.title: Audio Resampling & Channel Layout
sections.details: Resampling rates: Keep Original, 44.1 kHz, 48.0 kHz, 96.0 kHz, 192.0 kHz. Channel modes: Keep Original, Stereo (2 channels), Mono (1 channel). Bit depth: Source, 16-bit, 24-bit, 32-bit Float.

sections.title: Export Directory Strategy
sections.details: Destination options: Export alongside source file (same directory) or export to dedicated output folder (default: ./Converted). Safe overwrite handling.

sections.title: Start Transcoding (Batch Execution)
sections.details: Action: Click to start processing all tracks in the transcode queue. Non-blocking asynchronous task execution with live progress reporting and host Toast feedback upon completion.
